title: The whirlpool
prompt:

Create exactly ONE isolated game prop/creature, with true transparent background. No model sheet, labels, extra examples or stage backdrop. Canvas aspect ratio 800:260, intended delivery 800 x 260 pixels. Preserve the entire silhouette. Asset whirlpool.
